title: Archiving, deletion and restoration
question: What do archiving and deleting a project mean for its identity, history and data? Can either be undone? Should projects archive and delete themselves automatically after their planned end?
context: Today approved projects archive automatically at their planned end and are marked deleted 365 days later (PROJ-REQ-016). The manual archive and delete endpoints instead replace the project with a renamed Deleted copy (PROJ-REQ-017, PROJ-REQ-018). Neither behaviour has been approved.
